ios.desc:
App Store's highest-rated app to measure your Pupil Distance quickly and accurately. Measure your PD in seconds and order your next pair of glasses online for less.

PD, short for Pupillary Distance, is the distance between the center of your pupils in millimetres. This measurement is vital for the manufacturing of your prescription eyeglasses. This measurement is also useful for VR (Virtual Reality) Headsets.

App provides:
• Distance PD - For making regular glasses for everyday use.
• Reading PD - For making reading-only glasses, useful for phone/tablet use.
• Computer PD - Useful for desktop, laptop and notebook computers.
• VR PD - For use in Virtual Reality headsets.

Our app uses advanced algorithms to calculate your PD. Check out our positive reviews by thousands of satisfied customers.

------------

• For iPhone X and later models, use fully automated PD measurement in less than 3 seconds OR choose manual measurement method.
• Over 300 readings are taken and our advanced algorithm provides the most accurate results.

------------

• For models before iPhone X, Measure your PD in 3 quick steps.
• User-friendly interface and detailed help step-by-step.
• Advance algorithm fine-tuned over five years, calculates and gives precise results.
• Pupils are automatically detected.

quotes.text:
Most near-sighted developers would benefit from single vision readers with a focal length and PD (~3mm less than binocular distance PD) customized for the distance of their desktop monitor, laptop or tablet.  Now that a complete pair of glasses can be obtained online for $20-$60, there is little risk in trying "computer glasses" and seeing how your eyes feel.

Some optometrists add +1.00 to your distance prescription to obtain your computer prescription.  Some perform a separate eye test at laptop/monitor distance.  There's also a calculator here: http://computerglassesrx.com

If you wear contacts for hours at the computer, you can try cheap drugstore reading (plus) glasses over your contacts, close to the +value from above calculator.  Once you know what strength works for you, buy better quality readers from sites like readers.com, peepers.com, etc.  Or make custom ones with your near PD and preferred frame at Zenni, EyeBuyDirect, etc.

This iOS app can help with PD measurement, remember to hold the phone at the same distance as your laptop/monitor:  PD Meter | Pupil Distance Measure by GlassifyMe by GlassifyMe
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/pd-meter-pupil-distance-measure-by-glassifyme/id1041586910?mt=8
